description: This test file contains unit tests for a FastAPI application, specifically testing OpenAPI schema endpoint accessibility, documentation routes, and root endpoint behavior. It imports the application module dynamically, sets environment variables for testing, and verifies expected HTTP responses.

methods.name: TestClient get_client()
methods.description: Returns a TestClient instance for the FastAPI app, reloading the app module to ensure environment updates are reflected.

methods.name: test_disable_openapi(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Tests that the OpenAPI JSON, Docs, and Redoc routes return 404 when the OPENAPI_URL environment variable is cleared.

methods.name: test_root()
methods.description: Tests that the root endpoint '/'' returns a 200 status with expected JSON message.

methods.name: test_default_openapi()
methods.description: Verifies that the documentation endpoints return 200 status and that the OpenAPI JSON matches expected structure.
